recommendation: Keep the no-change audit as-is. Further edits for FHIR-2865 would be redundant; any future compartment URL changes should be handled under newer compartment-search issues.
issue_request: FHIR-2865 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core change request asking to clarify the ambiguous DSTU1 compartment search form GET [base]/[compartment]/[id]/? so readers would not confuse a compartment all-types search with reading the compartment-defining resource.
initial_application: Commit 04f196672ff2f42a31650ada7f0b8bc1ced2c70d explicitly applied FHIR-2865 by replacing the ambiguous GET [base]/[compartment]/[id]? form with GET [base]/[compartment]/[id]/*? and adding a note pointing all-patient-record retrieval to $everything.
additional_context: Current source/http.html still shows the [base]/[Compartment]/[id]/* form, explains that literal * means all types and distinguishes the search from a read, lists /[compartment]/[id]/*? as search-compartment, and links Patient/Encounter $everything operations. Later FHIR-51608 clarified adjacent compartment-search URL behavior and is already represented on the combined branch, while community searches found no conflicting FHIR-2865-specific record.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because the current source already conveys the requested clarification and no current build-scope source correction is needed.
